# Example: Guitarbot (teacher generated by the Builder Bot)

Acoustic guitar teacher **generated in simulation** from the interview in `simulated-interview.md`, using the Builder Bot template. It has not been tested with real learners: it is a format example, to review before any use.

- `PROMPT.md`: the prompt (same sections as the 5 bots, domain `guitar`).
- `skills/guitarbot-role/SKILL.md` and `skills/guitarbot-getting-started/SKILL.md`.
- `report-example.md`: a fictional report in the format the Profile Bot expects.
- Import name: "Grok Bot Academy - Guitarbot".
